The '''surveillance droid''' existed in many eras. They were used to monitor houses, business and warehouses for any possible threat. They flew slowly in lighted or dark places monitoring with their [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. Advanced models used [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] sensors for better results.
